statement: A platform principal holding cosec:breakglass on the platform document requests break-glass, publishes an approved request and revokes it alone: no other control action is needed, and cosec:breakglass stands in for cosec:publish on a break-glass change only. A request refused for want of it answers 403 before the platform document is read, whether or not a binding of that id exists.
guards: control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#cosec breakglass alone requests it, publishes what was approved and revokes it
control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#cosec breakglass does not stand in for cosec publish on any other change
control:BreakGlassAuthorityTest#a refused request tells nothing of the bindings there are
